The right Kiwi Browser alternative depends on what you need to keep. Quetta is an option for Chromium-style extensions and built-in video tools; Firefox offers Android add-ons through Mozilla; Brave focuses on built-in blocking. Edge, Samsung Internet and Chrome may fit better if your priority is an existing account or device workflow. [...] ## Frequently asked questions

### Which alternative is closest to Kiwi for extensions?

Quetta is worth evaluating for Chromium-style extension access. Firefox is another option when the tools you need have Android-compatible Mozilla versions. Choose using your actual extension list, not only the number of extensions a browser advertises.

### Do I need another Chromium browser?

Only if your workflow depends on a Chromium-specific extension or behavior. For ordinary browsing, a different browser engine may still meet your needs.

### Can I move all my Kiwi data automatically?

Do not assume so. Bookmarks, passwords, open tabs, website sessions and extension settings are separate types of data. Check the import options in both browsers and confirm the result before deleting anything.
